detail.longDescription: it’s so weird that my non male # kubernetes pals have interviews that include way more technical assessments than males that go for the same roles. some of the “do you really code” questions and “are you sure you’re not a k8s epm” - yall - you know you can assess for that right without sounding like a completely disconnected human?? and in this day and age where claude can do the code for you??? get out.
